note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Suriname: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Suriname bars anyone from having a child (under sixteen) work, paid or not, except as its 2018 child-labour law allows; for 'artistic performances' the Labour Inspectorate (Dienst Arbeidsinspectie) issues guidelines for employers, parents and carers on light work, distinguishing 13-14 and 15-year-olds, on maximum hours a day and week, Sunday and evening work, compulsory rest, and the required presence and supervision of supervisors, parents and carers. No individual permit is named and nothing allows a performer under thirteen (layer 3's reading); the guidelines themselves were not found. The article names performances (reading: a child writer or director is not covered).
figures.applies: Wet Arbeid Kinderen en Jeugdige Personen (S.B. 2018 no. 76) arts. 3, 7.

sources.said: 1. Het is werkgevers, hoofden en bestuurders van ondernemingen, ouders en/of voogden of personen aan wie de zorg van een kind is toevertrouwd verboden het kind al dan niet tegen loon arbeid te doen verrichten, anders dan bepaald in deze wet. ... De Dienst Arbeidsinspectie vaardigt richtlijnen uit voor werkgevers, ouders en verzorgers ter zake arbeid van lichte aard waarbij een onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen 13- en 14-jarigen en 15-jarigen, met betrekking tot: a) de maximale werktijden per dag en per week; b) het verrichten van arbeid op de zondag en in de avond; c) de verplichte rusttijden; d) de verplichte aanwezigheid van en supervisie en begeleiding door het toezichthoudend personeel, de ouders en de verzorgers tijdens de arbeid.

figures.finding: In Suriname a contract of employment with a child or young person (under eighteen) that the 2018 law allows must be made in writing, with the parents or carers co-signing. No set-aside of earnings was found; the rule reaches any employment (reading).

value.binding: written contract co-signed by parents or carers

sources.said: 4. De arbeidsovereenkomst met de kinderen en jeugdige personen zoals toegestaan in deze wet dient schriftelijk te worden aangegaan, waarbij de ouders of verzorgers meetekenen.

figures.finding: Suriname has no film fund of its own found; since 2026 Surinamese screenwriters, directors and producers may apply to the Netherlands Film Fund's Studio Caribe short-film scheme, with or without a producer attached; no age is stated on the announcement.
figures.applies: Netherlands Film Fund announcement of 29 January 2026.

sources.said: The scheme is aimed at screenwriters, directors and producers with an original film idea for the development of a short (children’s) film. ... Applications for this development round of Studio Caribe can be submitted with or without a producer attached.
